title: High-pass filter
summary: Cut everything below a frequency: rumble, handling noise, wind, mains hum. The magnitude of a Butterworth filter, −3 dB at the cutoff, applied with zero phase.

params.title: Cutoff
params.help: The level is 3 dB down here and falls by the slope below it.

params.title: Deepest cut
params.help: The cut never goes deeper than this; 0 leaves the audio untouched.
